additional_info.body:
Hello Heinrich,
Thank you for the quick feedback.
I am not sure if I understood the problem. Do you want the station to ask for pin or card, or no?
I checked the configuration and the authentication is not enabled:
Even though the authorization method is selected, the Required is not enabled. As such, it will try to charge as a NULL tag.
If you need this enabled, I will do it as soon as you reply to me.
Thanks!
Best regards,
Francisco
